title: Minuta 2025-05-15
summary: The minutes of the 15 May meeting record a unanimous 50bp cut to 8.50% and repeat the guidance that a similar-magnitude adjustment could follow, but they reveal a Board somewhat less uniformly dovish than the communique. Four members back the 50bp pace on weak activity (stagnation, a possible mild recession, deeper investment weakness, a cooling labor market), a firmer peso and a still-high ex-ante real rate, and one goes as far as saying further similar cuts are warranted even after the calibration ends. Against that, one member argues it is time to drop the 'similar magnitude' reference and make the current pace conditional on disinflation resuming, citing core stuck since November, upside risks and the gap with analysts' forecasts as a credibility issue, while another warns that a narrowing rate differential with the US will demand more gradualism later. Versus the March minutes, the majority's easing case is intact but the internal push to soften the forward guidance is new, which places the minutes a notch less dovish than the communique.

key_quotes.quote: Agregó que la guía prospectiva debe reflejar cautela y mencionar que el ritmo actual de recortes continuaría solo si se retoma el proceso desinflacionario de convergencia a la meta de 3%.
key_quotes.context: One member wants the guidance to drop the similar-magnitude reference and make the pace conditional on disinflation resuming

key_quotes.quote: Expresó que ajustes adicionales de magnitud similar a los implementados en las reuniones anteriores, aun concluido dicho proceso de calibración, son congruentes con la evolución reciente de las condiciones macroeconómicas.
key_quotes.context: The most dovish member sees further 50bp cuts even after calibration ends

key_quotes.quote: Mencionó que lo anterior terminará implicando, más adelante en el horizonte, una mayor gradualidad para las decisiones de política monetaria.
key_quotes.context: Another member flags that the narrowing differential will require more gradualism later

key_quotes.quote: Uno destacó que actualmente la economía pasa por un periodo de estancamiento y que pudiera materializarse una ligera recesión.
key_quotes.context: Weak activity is the core of the easing case
